# Lichess sGhFxtv2 before 25.Bh5, https://lichess.org/sGhFxtv2. Ember sees 25...Bxc3 26.bxc3 Qf5+ in its PV but undervalues the damage; deep Stockfish analysis prefers 25.a4, with 25.Bg4 also substantially safer.
sghfxtv2-25-bh5

# Lichess 62oWHyZN before 14...Ne4, https://lichess.org/62oWHyZN. The old quiescence check cap distorted the root by evaluating a still-checked leaf as if it were quiet; Stockfish dev at 100M nodes puts Bxc2 within 0.15 pawn of the best move and about 1.94 pawns above Ne4.
62owhyzn-14-bxc2

# Lichess PsmkiN5M before 19...Ng7, https://lichess.org/PsmkiN5M. Rules-correct search-local cycle handling changed the root tree and left the immediately recapturable Nxh4 exchange three plies beyond the depth-16 horizon; Stockfish 18 at 100M nodes prefers Nxh4 over Ng7 by about 1.19 pawns. Extend only recapturable equal-knight trades when no higher-value capture competes.
psmkin5m-19-nxh4

# Lichess aPSrt6iF before 21.d4, https://lichess.org/aPSrt6iF. In the game Ember spent 7 seconds and chose the central pawn shove; Stockfish 18 at 60 seconds prefers Qxa4 by about 1.8 pawns over d4 because Black's g-pawn/rook attack is already more important than the slow central passer plan.
apsrt6if-21-qxa4

# Lichess aPSrt6iF before 22.d5, https://lichess.org/aPSrt6iF. After 21...g4, Ember spent 29 seconds and continued the same faulty plan with d5; Stockfish 18 at 60 seconds prefers Nxe5 by about 2.6 pawns and shows 22.d5 gxf3 23.dxe6 Rxg2+ as the tactical punishment.
apsrt6if-22-nxe5

# Lichess mamfZxnW before 51.Re1, https://lichess.org/mamfZxnW. The later 65.Kd5 position is already forced-lost at deep Stockfish, but the earlier root cause is here: Ember played a quiet rook move while Stockfish 18 at 20 seconds prefers the immediate g4 break by about 1.2 pawns, keeping the rook/passed-pawn ending close to balanced.
mamfzxnw-51-g4

# Lichess VIVYb2Xq before 75.Rf7, https://lichess.org/VIVYb2Xq. Ember still won, and deeper Stockfish makes this only a conversion nit: Nb4/Ne7/Rf7 are all clearly winning, with Stockfish 18 at 15 seconds putting Nb4 about half a pawn above Rf7. Keep it as an optional cleanup target, not a release blocker.
vivyb2xq-75-nb4
